column1: # Every route whose reach includes a table with no tenant dimension, as
# ⭐ THE SET, NOT THE COUNT. A count is not an identity: one route added and one
# removed holds the number while the population changes underneath it. The
# published figures — 42 site-global writers, 33 of them on identity alone — are
# re-derived FROM these rows, so the file and the number cannot disagree.
# ⛔ `arm` says WHICH instrument answered. `walk` is the precise call walk and
# is what the published 42 counts; `module-reach` is the sound
# over-approximation used only where the walk reached no write at all, and a row
# carrying it is a reach, not a statement the route issues.
# Recorded by `SIGNOFF-REPAIR.7.1.1.1`. Refresh only with an adjudication:
